title: feat(grid): read-only cells say so in the grid, a cell save is said in one live region, a touch never edits in place (#35689 slice A)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XURgXCZHcjPoyo5g9cMEATi)_

Part of #35689 — slice A (touch, accessibility, checked rows). Slice B (a row moving to its new group, group subtotals and the footer total refreshing after a save) stays on the card for its own PR.

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 平板上点列表的一行只会打开记录，不会误进格子编辑；读屏软件移到不能改的格子会读出「只读」，格子保存后会读出「已保存：字段名」，失败时读出原因；其余用户无感。
- 列表行内编辑重做专题的收尾（无障碍与触屏部分），分组移动与合计刷新另开一个 PR。
- 出错时最坏是读屏软件少读或多读一句、平板上点到编辑按钮没反应，不影响保存的数据；可以直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes

Measured on `origin/main` before any edit (the dispatch's six mechanism assumptions):

1. **Touch.** A touch tap on a cell opens the record and never selects or edits (`isTouchPress`, from #35684): holds, pinned. One gap measured: a lookup cell's edit button (the pencil) is drawn at `opacity-0` once any pointer enters the cell and is still hit-testable, so a tap on the right edge of an unselected lookup cell landed on the invisible button and **opened the editor in place**. Fixed in `CellEditButton`: a finger entering an unselected cell does not draw the button, and a touch click on one drawn earlier for a mouse edits nothing. The explicit edit entry on touch is the record page (the tap opens it), per the card's 「通过记录页或显式的编辑入口」.
2. **`aria-readonly`.** Absent. Now, only when the table is `role="grid"`, a data cell that opens no editor carries `aria-readonly="true"`, and so does the type-catcher input that holds focus in the selected cell (the element a screen reader lands on). The selected cell reads the host's facts (`readOnlyReasonOf`, which asks `describeCell`); every other cell reads the table's own facts (`editable`, the column, `isRowEditable`), because `describeCell` is declared "asked when the reader acts on it, never per render" and the cell a reader moves to is the selected one.
3. **Live region.** Before: a per-cell `role="status"` span mounted with its state, its words only in `aria-label`, plus `role="alert"` on failure. A region that mounts with its content is often not announced, and a label is not live content. Now one persistent visually hidden `aria-live="polite"` region per table that saves per cell (`autosaves`), drawn for the table's whole life; a successful save writes "Saved: {column}" into it (new key `table.cellSavedAnnouncement`, all eleven packs), each saying in a node of its own so the same words twice are said twice. A failure stays with the existing cell alert, said once; the region drops the earlier "saved". The per-cell mark becomes `role="img"` with its existing label: named, never live, so no duplicate announcement.
4. **Focus after a picker panel closes** (`placement="below"`): measured, it already returns to the cell by Esc and by a pick (`focusSelectionRef`, #35688). Pinned, no source change.
5. **Selection frame contrast** (`border-2 border-primary`, WCAG 1.4.11, 3:1 needed): passes everywhere, no change. Token arithmetic (sRGB relative luminance) on the shipped themes:
   - Console light (`--primary` 211 100% 50% on `--background` white): 3.97; on the hover row (muted/40) 3.74; on a checked row (primary/5) 3.73; on a checked hovered or active-record row (primary/10) 3.49; on full muted 3.40.
   - Console dark (211 100% 60% on 240 6% 6%): 6.34; hover 5.83; checked 6.03; checked hover/active 5.67.
   - `@object-ui/components` default theme: 17.84 light, 19.09 dark, at least 14.53 on any row state.
6. **Selection.** `commitCellValue` stages one cell and never reads `selectedRowIds`; `selectionResetKey` moves only on bulk actions and refresh: holds, pinned.

## Tests

New card-named describes, each in the component's existing harness file:

- `data-table-select-first-35684.test.tsx`: a touch tap opens the record and a touch double-tap neither selects nor edits; a tap on an unselected lookup cell's edit button edits nothing (control: the mouse's click edits); the selected read-only cell carries `aria-readonly` on the cell and its focus, an editable one none; a table that edits nothing marks every cell; control: outside the grid no `aria-readonly`.
- `data-table-autosave-35685.test.tsx`: the region is there and silent before any save, says "Saved: Name" after one, a second saying is a new node, saving is not said, and the table holds exactly one live element; a refused save is said by the cell alert alone and the region empties; control: no region without per-cell save. With two rows checked, a cell edit sends one update of that one cell and both checks stay (no selection change emitted).
- `data-table-keys-35687.test.tsx`: a picker panel under the cell hands focus back to the cell on Esc and on a pick.

## Acceptance notes

- Not done here, by the card's split: slice B (a row moving to its new group after a save, group subtotals and the footer total refreshing) follows on its own PR.
- `aria-readonly` on cells other than the selected one reads the table's own facts only (`editable`, the column, `isRowEditable`); the host's per-cell facts (`describeCell`: field read-only, permission, approval lock) are asked of the selected cell alone, because `describeCell` is declared never to be asked per render. A screen reader moving cell to cell always lands on the selected cell, so the acceptance line holds; a reader browsing the table in its virtual mode hears the coarser answer on cells it does not select.
- A tap that lands on a lookup cell's edit button drawn earlier for a mouse (a hybrid device) now does nothing at all rather than editing; the row's click handler ignores clicks on buttons, so the tap does not open the record either. A finger alone never draws the button.
- Real screen-reader output (VoiceOver, NVDA) and a real iPad were not exercised; the pins are jsdom, and the claim about a region that mounts with its words is the general live-region behaviour, not a measurement here.
- Selection frame contrast: no change needed; the readings are in What changes.

## Verification

Read first (risk order):
1. `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx`, the `cellReadOnly` computation in the body-cell map: the one place `describeCell` is now asked during render, for the selected cell only.
2. Same file, `CellEditButton`: the touch guard (`selectedRef`, `pressedByRef`).
3. Same file, `autosaveRow`: where the region's words are set on success and cleared on failure.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/components/src/__tests__/data-table-autosave-35685.test.tsx`, expect every test passing, among them the two in "the result is said to assistive tech (objectstack#35689)".

NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:type-check-debt`, reason: exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET (its closure build never got a turn on the shared verify lock); CI's Lint and Repo Gates runs it. `pnpm check:nul-bytes` re-run on 2c776b47: exit 0.
